# TC.Config.Read.SectionValues

Source: public `api/` declarations. [All public types and globals](../types.md).

<a id="symbol-TC.Config.Read.SectionValues"></a>

### TC.Config.Read.SectionValues

Section values. Addition defaults active=true, group empty, multiplier=1; local filters empty. Group joins inherit shared filters. Unknown fields refused.

### active (optional)

Section activation; addSection default true. Explicit root patch clear: not supported.

```text
boolean
```

### filters (optional)

Complete section filter replacement; addSection defaults empty only for a local group. Explicit root patch clear: not supported.

```text
(TC.Config.Read.SectionFilter)[]
```

### group (optional)

Shared-group name; empty string is local and is addSection default. Explicit root patch clear: not supported.

```text
string
```

### multiplier (optional)

Section output multiplier; addSection default 1, readback uses native float32 precision. Finite native numeric readback; generic Data limits still apply. Explicit root patch clear: not supported.

```text
number
```
